title: AGSoft Crop Face: face mask, detection cache, one wire to Crop Stitch
summary: A ComfyUI node that finds faces with RetinaFace, crops around them with a scale factor, X/Y offset and nine aspect presets, and now also outputs a face mask, caches detections and connects to Crop Stitch in one wire.

links.label: Announcement with examples, the author's Telegram post
